summary.coverage_notes: Search coverage included Google-style local/place queries for cafe, coffee shop, kopi, warung kopi, and brunch around Karapyak; Instagram hashtag/location-style results for kopikarapyak, cafekarapyak, and karapyakcafe; Google web queries for best cafe, digital nomad cafe, and Wi-Fi cafe Karapyak Pangandaran; and Tripadvisor Cafe/Coffee & Tea style discovery. Karapyak has a very small cafe ecosystem compared with Pangandaran Beach and Batu Karas. The strongest publishable candidates are Nuya Cafe Food and Drink, Karapyak Glamping & Lodges, and REY HOUSE CAFE. Most missing fields are Wi-Fi speed, power outlets, exact coffee price, and verified Google Maps place URLs.
